newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on Abercrombie & Fitch.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on Abercrombie & Fitch.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said on Thursday it would list options on Abercrombie & Fitch Co on October 3.

The options will have initial expiration months of October, November, February and May, with opening strike prices of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2. The strikes will be confirmed the day before trading starts.
In their Wall Street debut on Thursday, Abercrombie shares were up 6-1/4 at 22-1/4 in early afternoon trading.
The options will trade in the Wal-Mart Stores crowd. --Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
